questions: Did your walking problem begin suddenly, over hours or days?
Do you have weakness or numbness on one side of your body?
Have you had trouble speaking, seeing, or understanding speech with this problem?
Have you recently fallen or nearly fallen?
Do you feel dizzy or as though the room is spinning when you walk?
Do you feel unsteady even when standing still?
Do your feet sometimes feel stuck to the floor when you try to start walking?
Have your steps become noticeably shorter or more shuffling?
Do you have a tremor in your hands or legs when they are relaxed?
Have you noticed stiffness or slowness in your movements?
Do you have pain in your hips, knees, legs, or feet when walking?
Do you have numbness or reduced sensation in your feet?
Does your walking improve when you use a cane, walker, or hold onto something?
Is your walking noticeably different when you think nobody is watching?
Have you recently started or increased any medications that cause drowsiness or affect movement?
Have you recently had a stroke, head injury, infection, or other serious illness?
